Gentle polished realistic 3D illustration, believable hands and eyes. Entire boat and all props contained within portrait canvas with 4 percent safety margins top/bottom/sides, no cropped mast or rudder. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. No surrounding environment, no horizon, no island, no floor or backdrop, no UI, no scene title, no text except existing stern brand emblem. No broad sea rectangle. No water wake; website layers a separate wake asset behind the boat. Output a single individual scene, not a collage or sheet.
